cloud.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game sky cloud atlas, landscape 1536x1024. Create ORIGINAL painterly stylized cream-white cumulus cloud banks for a sunny hand-painted 3D desert-suburb game. This is a production sprite sheet, not a scene or mockup. True transparent background, no blue sky, no ground, no frame, no text. A precisely 2-column by 2-row grid containing FOUR separate entire cloud silhouettes, one wholly inside each quadrant with generous transparent gutters at every quadrant edge; never touch or cross a quadrant boundary. Each bank is broad horizontally (about 2.4 to 3 times wider than tall) viewed from below/front from a great distance, with a graceful flattened tapering lower edge and towering rounded clusters of many irregular small fluffy scallops above. Each cloud is a single connected coherent mass; occasional tiny attached wisps are okay. Distinct asymmetric bank shapes, not duplicates. Painterly flat color patches with gently softened transitions, rich warm ivory/cream sunlit crowns (#fff3d6), very pale peach lights, soft light periwinkle/lavender underside shadows (#b8c8ee). Layered visibly articulated puffs and light planes as in a high-quality stylized game background. Fine edges stay crisp and irregular rather than fuzzy photographic fog, no heavy dark outline. Avoid smooth 3D marshmallow ellipsoids, hard facets, grey storm shadows, cartoon outlines, concentric patterns or separated floating balls. Sunlight from upper left. Fit all four clouds entirely within their quadrants and preserve ample transparent padding, real alpha.

mountain.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent distant mountain scenery atlas for a sunny painterly 3D desert-suburb game. Landscape PNG 1536x1024, true transparent background. Production texture sheet containing TWO DIFFERENT continuous wide panoramic mountain ranges, stacked in two horizontal rows; each range stays entirely inside its half of the sheet with transparent separation. The upper half contains one uninterrupted range, the lower half another, each approximately 4:1 width to height. Both silhouettes fill width from 8% to 92%, with ends tapering down near their own base level, ample transparent side margin. Entire mountains only: transparent sky above; no sky color, no clouds, no buildings, no text, no trees, no water. Rugged southwestern desert mountains seen many miles away, multiple interlocking peaks, pointed varied summits, long rolling foothills at base, prominent vertical eroded ridges, sloping planar gullies. Light atmospheric hazy distance. Sunlit faces apricot/peach sandstone (#eaa17f), pale golden peach highlights (#f0b696), shadows muted periwinkle/lavender (#9a92c2), farther ridge peaks hazy bluish lavender (#aab2d2). Painterly broad angular color planes with some subtle fine ridge facets, clean silhouette, not photorealistic or outlined cartoon. Sunny midday light from upper left. The ranges each have a narrow solid opaque sandy peach basal strip along their whole base so overlapping cards form a continuous horizon, fading only at extreme left/right ends. Each range is unique, with one tall peak off-centre and several varied supporting peaks, no repeated pattern. Flattened natural front elevation, no perspective ground plane, no separate islands. Keep wholly within row boundaries. Real alpha transparency around each isolated range.
